result: Final live-player QA passes all requested commands and static regression checks. Startup exceptions clear RconEndpoint; SocketException/IOException wrap as RconUnavailableException and handlers map them to 503. Source-RCON validates auth id/type/body, command response id/type, bounded framing, timeout, and common command-error bodies. RCON is loopback-only, ephemeral, not persisted or exposed through Docker ports/logs, and cleared on stop/exit/failure. Running/unavailable guards, 400 validation, 429 live-control rate limiting, CSRF/audit integration, viewer read-only behavior, admin/owner controls, confirmations, and polling cleanup are present. No real Factorio/RCON server was available; transport validation is static plus fixture-oriented unit coverage.

evidence.outcome: Passed; Vite production build completed with existing SignalR Rollup annotation warnings.
Auth/command response IDs and types are validated; auth body must be empty; command error bodies rejected; timeout/socket/IO failures map to unavailable.
RconEndpoint uses loopback free port and random per-process password; startup catch and stop/exit clear it.
Unavailable maps 503, stopped maps 409, validation maps 400, and mutations retain rate limiter/CSRF/audit/role filters.
Viewer live read-only controls; admin/owner confirmed chat/kick/ban and persistent-list mutations; polling cleanup on unmount.
Focused parser/input and RCON-related tests included; no real Factorio process started.

next_slice.summary: Live-player milestone QA is complete. Optional future work is a real Source-RCON integration test against a Factorio fixture/server and an explicit documented fallback policy if degraded stdin behavior is desired.
